name: Bonacich
definition: Bonacich power centrality of every node for a given attenuation exponent.

name: Closeness
definition: Closeness of every node: the inverse of its mean distance to the nodes it reaches, with the unreachable-node rule of the chosen tool.

name: Betweenness subset
definition: Betweenness of nodes and edges for chosen sources and targets (Brandes 2008), which includes betweenness from a sample of sources.

name: Communicability
definition: Communicability of every pair of nodes: the matrix exponential of the adjacency matrix, per component (Estrada and Hatano 2008).

name: Communicability betweenness
definition: Communicability betweenness of every node: the loss of communicability when the node's edges are removed (Estrada, Higham and Hatano 2009).

name: Cx current flow
definition: Current-flow (random-walk) betweenness of every node and edge, from the grounded inverse of the Laplacian.

name: Current flow approx
definition: Current-flow betweenness approximated from sampled pairs of nodes (random pairs or given ones).

name: Current flow closeness
definition: Current-flow closeness of every node: the inverse of its mean resistance distance to the others (information centrality, Brandes and Fleischer 2005).

name: Current flow subset
definition: Current-flow betweenness of every node and edge for flow between given source and target nodes.

name: Dispersion
definition: Dispersion of the tie between each given pair of nodes (Backstrom and Kleinberg), one value per pair.

name: Edge load
definition: Load on every edge: NetworkX's edge load centrality, over ordered pairs of adjacent nodes.

name: Load
definition: Load centrality of every node: flow split equally among predecessors (Goh, Kahng and Kim 2001).

name: Percolation
definition: Percolation centrality of every node for given percolation states (Piraveenan, Prokopenko and Hossain 2013).

name: Reaching
definition: Global reaching centrality of a network (Mones et al.): the mean gap between the largest local reaching centrality and every node's, divided by n - 1.

name: Resistance
definition: Resistance distance between every pair of nodes, infinite across components (Klein and Randic 1993).

name: Second order
definition: Second-order centrality of every node: the standard deviation of its return times in a random walk (Kermarrec et al. 2011).

name: Trophic
definition: Trophic incoherence parameter of a directed network: the standard deviation of the trophic differences (Johnson et al.).

name: Voterank
definition: VoteRank: up to a given number of influential spreaders, chosen one at a time by voting, in the order chosen.

name: Edge betweenness
definition: Shortest-path betweenness of every edge (Brandes 2001 accumulation, as used by Girvan and Newman).

name: Eigenvector
definition: Eigenvector centrality of every node, with the principal eigenvalue and a connectedness flag.

name: Flow betweenness
definition: Flow betweenness of every node: the share of maximum flow between other pairs that cannot avoid it. The ucinet convention uses the normalized scale; UCINET's documentation does not define its normalization precisely, so the all_pairs and max scales are offered as other readings.

name: Group / betweenness
definition: Group degree, closeness or betweenness of a set of nodes (Everett and Borgatti).

name: Group / closeness
definition: Group degree, closeness or betweenness of a set of nodes (Everett and Borgatti).

name: Group / degree
definition: Group degree, closeness or betweenness of a set of nodes (Everett and Borgatti).

name: Harmonic
definition: Harmonic centrality of every node: the sum of 1/d over the other nodes (0 for an unreachable one).

name: Hits
definition: Hub and authority scores of every node (Kleinberg 1999), with the leading singular value.

name: Information centrality
definition: Stephenson and Zelen's information centrality of every node.

name: Katz
definition: Katz centrality of every node by fixed-point iteration (Katz 1953).

name: Kpp_optimum / distance_fragmentation
definition: The set of k key players that best satisfies a key player criterion (Borgatti's greedy swap search or exact enumeration), with its score.

name: Kpp_optimum / distance_reach
definition: The set of k key players that best satisfies a key player criterion (Borgatti's greedy swap search or exact enumeration), with its score.

name: Kpp_optimum / fragmentation
definition: The set of k key players that best satisfies a key player criterion (Borgatti's greedy swap search or exact enumeration), with its score.

name: Kpp_optimum / m_reach
definition: The set of k key players that best satisfies a key player criterion (Borgatti's greedy swap search or exact enumeration), with its score.

name: Kpp_single / distance_fragmentation
definition: Key player criterion (fragmentation, distance-weighted fragmentation, m-reach or distance-weighted reach) of a given set of nodes.

name: Kpp_single / distance_reach
definition: Key player criterion (fragmentation, distance-weighted fragmentation, m-reach or distance-weighted reach) of a given set of nodes.

name: Kpp_single / fragmentation
definition: Key player criterion (fragmentation, distance-weighted fragmentation, m-reach or distance-weighted reach) of a given set of nodes.

name: Kpp_single / m_reach
definition: Key player criterion (fragmentation, distance-weighted fragmentation, m-reach or distance-weighted reach) of a given set of nodes.

name: Nxp eigenvector
definition: NetworkX's power-iteration eigenvector centrality, reproduced step for step; reports when it does not converge.

name: Nxp hits
definition: NetworkX's hubs and authorities iteration, reproduced step for step; reports when it does not converge.

name: Nxp katz
definition: NetworkX's Katz centrality iteration, reproduced step for step; reports when it does not converge.

name: Nxp pagerank
definition: NetworkX's PageRank iteration, reproduced step for step; reports when it does not converge.

name: Pagerank
definition: PageRank of every node by power iteration (Brin and Page 1998), with a GAP-suite preset.

name: Neighborhood inclusion, positional dominance, rank intervals
definition: Neighborhood inclusion, positional dominance, rank intervals.

name: Reach
definition: Number (or share) of other nodes within distance k of every node.

name: Walks ppr
definition: Personalized PageRank by the local push of Andersen, Chung and Lang: estimates below the exact value by at most the residual.

name: Factions errors
definition: Factions: a partition into k groups that best fits the ideal pattern of ties inside groups only, by tabu search from random starts.

name: K plexes
definition: Maximal k-plexes: node sets in which each member has at most k - 1 non-neighbours among the others.

name: K truss
definition: The k-truss: the edges in at least k - 2 triangles of the subgraph, and the nodes they touch.

name: Lambda connectivity
definition: Edge connectivity between every pair of nodes, read off Gusfield's flow tree.

name: Lambda sets
definition: Gusfield's equivalent flow tree: each node's parent and the edge connectivity to it (n - 1 maximum flows).

name: Max cliques
definition: Every maximal clique with at least min_size members, in lexicographic order.

name: N clans
definition: n-clans: the n-cliques whose induced subgraph also has diameter at most n.

name: N cliques
definition: n-cliques: maximal sets whose members are all within distance n of each other in the whole network.

name: Onion
definition: Onion layer of every node, from 1: the round of the core peeling in which it is removed.

name: Truss
definition: Truss number of every edge: the largest k whose k-truss contains it.

name: Cnx current flow
definition: Component labels after removing the edges of largest current-flow betweenness until at least k components exist (NetworkX's edge current-flow partition).

name: Cnx edge betweenness
definition: Component labels after removing the most central edges one at a time until at least k components exist (NetworkX's edge betweenness partition).

name: K clique
definition: Clique percolation communities: unions of maximal cliques of at least k nodes that share k - 1 nodes.

name: Fast greedy
definition: Greedy modularity communities by repeated best mergers (Clauset, Newman and Moore); returns the best level, its modularity and the mergers.

name: Fluid communities
definition: Fluid communities of a connected undirected network: k groups found by density-propagating sweeps.

name: Girvan newman
definition: Girvan-Newman clustering by removing the edge of highest betweenness one at a time; returns the best level, its modularity, the removal order and the modularity path.

name: Label propagation
definition: Label propagation communities: every node repeatedly takes the dominant label among the nodes it reads.

name: Leading eigen
definition: Leading eigenvector communities by repeated modularity-matrix splits (Newman); returns the membership, its modularity and the number of splits.

name: Leiden
definition: Leiden communities of an undirected network: local moving, refinement into connected groups and aggregation.

name: Louvain modularity
definition: Louvain communities of an undirected network by greedy modularity moves and aggregation.

name: Louvain quality
definition: Louvain communities of an undirected network by greedy modularity moves and aggregation.

name: Label spreading
definition: NetworkX's label spreading (harmonic function or local and global consistency): best class of every node and whether it ties.

name: Optimal modularity
definition: A partition of maximum modularity found exactly by Russian doll search.

name: Spinglass
definition: Spinglass communities of a connected network by simulated annealing of a Potts Hamiltonian (Reichardt and Bornholdt).

name: LocalGreedy, Moca, partition polishing, initial partitions
definition: LocalGreedy, Moca, partition polishing, initial partitions.

name: Walktrap
definition: Walktrap communities by merging nodes whose random-walk distributions are close; returns the best level, its modularity, the mergers and the modularity path.

name: All pairs node
definition: Local node connectivity of every ordered pair, as an n-by-n matrix.

name: Average node
definition: Local node connectivity of every ordered pair, as an n-by-n matrix.

name: Connectivity
definition: Global edge connectivity: the fewest edges whose removal disconnects the network.

name: Edge cut
definition: A smallest set of edges whose removal disconnects the network.

name: Gomory hu
definition: The Gomory-Hu tree of an undirected network: each node's parent and the minimum cut value to it (Gusfield).

name: Gomory hu values
definition: The Gomory-Hu tree of an undirected network: each node's parent and the minimum cut value to it (Gusfield).

name: Max flow
definition: Maximum flow from a set of sources to a set of sinks (Dinic), with the flow on every edge.

name: Max flow min cost
definition: A maximum flow of least cost between two nodes, with its value.

name: Min cut
definition: Minimum cut between a set of sources and a set of sinks: its capacity, the source side and the crossing edges.

name: Node cut
definition: A smallest set of nodes whose removal disconnects the network.

name: Attribute to matrix (same, difference, sender, receiver)
definition: Attribute to matrix (same, difference, sender, receiver).

name: Tucker congruence, factor rotation, iterative proportional fitting, state transitions
definition: Tucker congruence, factor rotation, iterative proportional fitting, state transitions.

name: Multiplex coding of several relations into one matrix
definition: Multiplex coding of several relations into one matrix.

name: Normalize ties (row, column, matrix; sum, mean, max, z, Euclidean, IPF)
definition: Normalize ties (row, column, matrix; sum, mean, max, z, Euclidean, IPF).

name: Full symmetrize method set and dichotomize by density
definition: Full symmetrize method set and dichotomize by density.

name: Average clustering
definition: Mean local clustering coefficient over the nodes.

name: Centralization / betweenness
definition: Freeman centralization of degree, betweenness, closeness or eigenvector centrality.

name: Centralization / closeness
definition: Freeman centralization of degree, betweenness, closeness or eigenvector centrality.

name: Centralization / degree
definition: Freeman centralization of degree, betweenness, closeness or eigenvector centrality.

name: Centralization eigenvector
definition: Freeman centralization of degree, betweenness, closeness or eigenvector centrality.

name: Clustering
definition: Local clustering coefficient of every node: the share of pairs of its neighbours that are tied.

name: Components
definition: Weak or strong components: a label for every node and the size of each component.

name: Effective resistance
definition: Effective graph resistance (Kirchhoff index): the sum of resistance distances over all node pairs (Ellens et al. 2011).

name: Kemeny
definition: Kemeny's constant of the random walk: the expected steps to reach a stationary-distributed node, the same from every start.

name: Degree
definition: Degree of every node: edge endpoints by direction, loops counted twice.

name: Degree distribution and its summary statistics
definition: Degree distribution and its summary statistics.

name: Ego size
definition: Number of nodes within a range of steps from each node (ego included when the range starts at 0).

name: Krackhardt graph-theoretic dimensions (connectedness, hierarchy, efficiency, LUBness)
definition: Krackhardt graph-theoretic dimensions (connectedness, hierarchy, efficiency, LUBness).

name: Triangles
definition: Number of triangles at each node of the simple undirected reading of the network.

name: Weak and strong transitivity; directed and weighted clustering conventions
definition: Weak and strong transitivity; directed and weighted clustering conventions.

name: Square clustering
definition: Square clustering of every node: the share of possible squares through it that exist.

name: Transitivity
definition: Transitivity of the simple undirected reading of the network: closed triples over connected triples.

name: Triad census
definition: The 16 triad counts in MAN order (Holland and Leinhardt), one value per triad type.

name: Normalized reciprocity and transitivity, DKS transitivity, cyclicity
definition: Normalized reciprocity and transitivity, DKS transitivity, cyclicity.

name: Ego composition: alter shares, Blau and Shannon heterogeneity, IQV
definition: Ego composition: alter shares, Blau and Shannon heterogeneity, IQV.

name: Correlated and bipartite random graph generators
definition: Correlated and bipartite random graph generators.

name: Deterministic realisation of a degree sequence
definition: Deterministic realisation of a degree sequence.

name: Static fitness and static power-law generators
definition: Static fitness and static power-law generators.

name: Clique, regular and bow-tie generators; all graphs of size n
definition: Clique, regular and bow-tie generators; all graphs of size n.

name: Rich club
definition: Rich-club coefficient of an undirected network for every degree, optionally normalized by degree-preserving randomizations.

name: Small world
definition: Small-world coefficient omega of a connected undirected network against random and lattice references (Telesford et al.).

name: Swap contract
definition: Connectivity-preserving double edge swaps of a connected undirected network, as the rewired edge list and the number of swaps kept.

name: Clique removal
definition: Ramsey-based clique removal: a large independent set and the disjoint cliques removed.

name: Densest
definition: Densest subgraph of a simple undirected network by Greedy++ peeling, as the best density and its nodes.

name: Ap dominating set
definition: Greedy dominating set of least node weight (weight per newly covered node), as node ids in the order chosen.

name: Node connectivity
definition: Approximate node connectivity of the whole network by greedy node-disjoint shortest paths.

name: Treewidth
definition: Tree decomposition of a simple undirected network by an elimination heuristic: the bags, the edges between bags and the width.

name: Tw min degree
definition: Tree decomposition of a simple undirected network by an elimination heuristic: the bags, the edges between bags and the width.

name: Ap vertex cover
definition: Local-ratio vertex cover of least node cost (2-approximation), as node ids.

name: Automorphism group, count and canonical form
definition: Automorphism group, count and canonical form.

name: Ahuja Orlin Sharma Cyclic Exchange Local Augmentation
definition: Ahuja Orlin Sharma Cyclic Exchange Local Augmentation.

name: Greedy color
definition: A greedy colouring: the colour of every node, from 0, by one of seven node-order strategies.

name: Link prediction
definition: Link prediction score of each listed pair of nodes: common neighbors, Jaccard, Adamic-Adar and the other neighborhood indices.

name: Max weight matching
definition: A maximum-weight matching of an undirected network, as input edge positions (blossom algorithm).

name: Min basis
definition: A minimum cycle basis of an undirected network and the weight of each cycle (de Pina).

name: Min basis weights
definition: A minimum cycle basis of an undirected network and the weight of each cycle (de Pina).

name: Min weight matching
definition: A matching of least total weight among the matchings of largest size, as input edge positions.

name: Mis
definition: A random maximal independent set containing the start nodes (or one random node), nodes in increasing order.

name: Panther
definition: The k nodes most similar to a source by Panther: how often random paths contain both (Zhang et al. 2015).

name: Planarity testing, embedding and straight-line drawing
definition: Planarity testing, embedding and straight-line drawing.

name: Simple cycles
definition: Every simple cycle, by Johnson's search or a bounded depth-first search.

name: Simrank
definition: SimRank similarity of every pair of nodes: two nodes are similar when their in-neighbors are (Jeh and Widom 2002).

name: ANOVA density models (constant/variable homophily, structural blockmodel)
definition: ANOVA density models (constant/variable homophily, structural blockmodel).

name: Goldberg Maximum Density Subgraph Algorithm Base
definition: Goldberg Maximum Density Subgraph Algorithm Base.

name: Goldberg Maximum Density Subgraph Algorithm Node Weight Per Edge Weight
definition: Goldberg Maximum Density Subgraph Algorithm Node Weight Per Edge Weight.

name: Goldberg Maximum Density Subgraph Algorithm Node Weights
definition: Goldberg Maximum Density Subgraph Algorithm Node Weights.

name: Conditional uniform graph tests and null models
definition: Conditional uniform graph tests and null models.

name: Network autocorrelation: lag/error model, Moran, Geary
definition: Network autocorrelation: lag/error model, Moran, Geary.

name: QAP correlation (Y-permutation, exact and Monte Carlo)
definition: QAP correlation (Y-permutation, exact and Monte Carlo).

name: UCINET DL text read and write
definition: UCINET DL text read and write.

name: Extra file formats: ncol, lgl, dimacs, graphdb, adjacency list
definition: Extra file formats: ncol, lgl, dimacs, graphdb, adjacency list.

name: Multi-matrix DL, edgelist23, nodelist, ranklist, pilesort, VNA
definition: Multi-matrix DL, edgelist23, nodelist, ranklist, pilesort, VNA.

name: Barycenter Greedy Two Layered Bipartite Layout2 D
definition: Barycenter Greedy Two Layered Bipartite Layout2 D.

name: Median Greedy Two Layered Bipartite Layout2 D
definition: Median Greedy Two Layered Bipartite Layout2 D.

name: Layout stress quality
definition: Stress-majorization layout: two coordinates per node whose distances approximate the graph distances, on all pairs or on pivots.

name: Layout stress value
definition: Stress-majorization layout: two coordinates per node whose distances approximate the graph distances, on all pairs or on pivots.

name: Graph spectrum (eigenvalues of a graph matrix)
definition: Graph spectrum (eigenvalues of a graph matrix).

name: Graph matrix operators (adjacency, Laplacian, Hashimoto, incidence)
definition: Graph matrix operators (adjacency, Laplacian, Hashimoto, incidence).

name: Missing: impute node-level missing row from column (undirected) or from the opposite-direction relation (directed)
definition: Missing: impute node-level missing row from column (undirected) or from the opposite-direction relation (directed).

name: Structural equivalence: profile (correlation, Euclidean, etc ), similarities and distance measures (Jaccard, matches, Hamming, Manhattan), diagonal options (Row
definition: Structural equivalence: profile (correlation, Euclidean, etc ), similarities and distance measures (Jaccard, matches, Hamming, Manhattan), diagonal options (Row.

name: Minimum/maximum cycle ratio and mean cycle
definition: Minimum/maximum cycle ratio and mean cycle.

name: Barycenter
definition: The nodes of smallest total distance to the others, and every node's total distance.

name: Center
definition: Nodes of smallest eccentricity; empty unless the network is (strongly) connected, as in NetworkX.

name: Closeness vitality
definition: Wiener index of the network minus that of the network without the node, for every node.

name: Index
definition: Sum of the distances over unordered pairs (ordered pairs in a directed network); infinite unless connected.

name: Local efficiency
definition: Mean over the nodes of the global efficiency of the subgraph induced by each node's neighbors.

name: Periphery
definition: Nodes of largest eccentricity; empty unless the network is (strongly) connected, as in NetworkX.

name: Eccentricity
definition: Each node's largest distance to the nodes it reaches.

name: Mean distance
definition: Mean shortest-path distance over ordered pairs of distinct nodes joined by a path.

name: Neighborhood function, hop plot, effective diameter
definition: Neighborhood function, hop plot, effective diameter.

name: Paths sssp
definition: Shortest-path lengths from one node by Delta-stepping; infinity for unreached nodes.

name: Radius
definition: The smallest eccentricity (NaN for a network without nodes).

name: Automorphic equivalence
definition: Orbits of the automorphism group of the binary ties: nodes that map to each other under some automorphism share a label.

name: Direct blockmodel search (structural, regular, generalised block types)
definition: Direct blockmodel search (structural, regular, generalised block types).

name: Egotize (6 750), Ego network extraction with tab "Ego"
definition: Egotize (6 750), Ego network extraction with tab "Ego".

name: Structural holes (Burt): effective size, efficiency, constraint, hierarchy, dyadic redundancy and constraint (dyadicconstraint 6 798), "corrected constraint" FA
definition: Structural holes (Burt): effective size, efficiency, constraint, hierarchy, dyadic redundancy and constraint (dyadicconstraint 6 798), "corrected constraint" FA.

name: Automorphic (Max Sim) and regular equivalence (REGE, CATREGE)
definition: Automorphic (Max Sim) and regular equivalence (REGE, CATREGE).

name: Concor
definition: CONCOR blocks: repeated splits of the nodes by iterated correlation of their correlation matrix, numbered from 1.

name: Core periphery
definition: Discrete core-periphery fit: the core membership that best matches the ideal pattern, by tabu search from random starts.

name: Core periphery continuous
definition: Continuous core-periphery fit: a coreness score per node by MINRES or by correlation with the pattern c_i c_j.

name: Cognitive social structures with accuracy measures
definition: Cognitive social structures with accuracy measures.

name: Equivalence measures: matches, positive matches, overlaps, cross-products, coverage
definition: Equivalence measures: matches, positive matches, overlaps, cross-products, coverage.

name: Guttman scaling, K-means and quick clustering
definition: Guttman scaling, K-means and quick clustering.

name: Structural equivalence
definition: Pairwise structural equivalence of all nodes: Euclidean distance, correlation or Hamming distance between their tie profiles.

name: Structural balance, frustration index, signed blockmodels
definition: Structural balance, frustration index, signed blockmodels.

name: Ergm mcmle
definition: Monte Carlo maximum-likelihood estimate of an exponential-random-graph model by Geyer-Thompson rounds of simulation from the current coefficients, started at the pseudo-likelihood estimate or at given coefficients; returns the coefficients, standard errors from the simulated covariance, the rounds, the convergence and the largest t-ratio. The terms are named from the ERGM vocabulary; the node attributes are the columns of the call.

name: Ergm mple
definition: Maximum pseudo-likelihood estimate of an exponential-random-graph model by Newton iterations on the pooled change statistics; returns the coefficients, their standard errors, the iterations, the convergence and the log pseudo-likelihood. The terms are named from the ERGM vocabulary; the node attributes are the columns of the call.

name: Ergm sim mean
definition: Draws from an exponential-random-graph model by Metropolis-Hastings toggles started at the given network; returns the statistics of every draw (chain by chain) and the acceptance rate of each chain. The terms are named from the ERGM vocabulary; the node attributes are the columns of the call.

name: Power-law fit of a degree distribution
definition: Power-law fit of a degree distribution.

name: Saom sim mean
definition: Simulates periods of network change under a stochastic actor-oriented model (Snijders): actors take ministeps at a common rate and toggle one tie by a multinomial logit of the objective function; returns, per run, the target statistics followed by the changed ties, the ministeps taken and no networks. The effects are named from the SAOM vocabulary; the covariates are the columns of the call.

name: Sbm fit
definition: Stochastic block model fit by minimum description length: agglomerative start, annealed and Markov chain refinement, best of several restarts; returns the blocks, their number and the description length with its parts.

name: Stochastic block models for partially observed networks
definition: Stochastic block models for partially observed networks.

name: Incremental maintenance on a changing graph
definition: Incremental maintenance on a changing graph.

name: All topological
definition: Every topological order of a DAG, in the sequence of Knuth and Szwarcfiter's algorithm.

name: Branching
definition: Optimum branching or spanning arborescence of a directed network (Edmonds), as input edge positions and total weight.

name: Ahuja Orlin Sharma Capacitated Minimum Spanning Tree
definition: Ahuja Orlin Sharma Capacitated Minimum Spanning Tree.

name: Esau Williams Capacitated Minimum Spanning Tree
definition: Esau Williams Capacitated Minimum Spanning Tree.

name: Closure
definition: The pairs (u, v) of the transitive closure, sorted by source then target.

name: Dag lca
definition: Lowest common ancestor of each node pair in a DAG; pairs with no common ancestor get the none mark u32::MAX.

name: Antichain width
definition: The width of a DAG: the size of a largest antichain (Dilworth), by a maximum matching on the reachability pairs.

name: Spanning trees
definition: Number of spanning trees (arborescences rooted at the root for a directed network) by the matrix-tree theorem.

name: Generations
definition: Topological generations of a DAG: the roots, then the nodes all of whose parents are in earlier generations.

name: Idom
definition: Immediate dominator of every node reachable from the start node (the start's is itself); unreachable nodes get the none mark u32::MAX.

name: Longest length
definition: A longest path of a DAG and its length, by dynamic programming in topological order.

name: Longest path
definition: A longest path of a DAG and its length, by dynamic programming in topological order.

name: Reduction
definition: The arcs of the transitive reduction of a DAG, sorted by source then target.

name: Rst edge freq
definition: A random spanning tree of a connected undirected network by Wilson's algorithm, as input edge positions.

name: Spanning tree
definition: Minimum or maximum spanning forest of an undirected network, as input edge positions and total weight.

name: Spanning weight
definition: Minimum or maximum spanning forest of an undirected network, as input edge positions and total weight.

name: Bfs layers
definition: Levels, parents and counts of a breadth-first search from one node (direction-optimizing).

name: Birank
definition: BiRank scores of both node sets of a bipartite graph: the fixed point of damped, normalized propagation between the sets.

name: Butterflies
definition: Butterflies (4-cycles) at each node, counted over wedges of the lower-ranked endpoint.

name: Hopcroft karp
definition: A maximum matching of a bipartite graph as each node's mate (-1 if unmatched), by Hopcroft and Karp.

name: Min weight full matching
definition: A full matching of least total cost of a bipartite graph, as each node's mate (-1 if unmatched).

name: Project
definition: One-mode projection of a two-mode network onto either mode, with count, Newman or product weights.

name: Two-mode projection weights (covariance, correlation, Jaccard, Bonacich, cosine)
definition: Two-mode projection weights (covariance, correlation, Jaccard, Bonacich, cosine).

name: Twomode / betweenness
definition: Betweenness of every node in a two-mode network, optionally divided by the largest possible value (Borgatti and Everett 1997).

name: Twomode / closeness
definition: Closeness of every node in a two-mode network, normalized by the bounds of Borgatti and Everett (1997).

name: Twomode / eigenvector
definition: Eigenvector centrality of a two-mode network: the leading singular vectors of the incidence matrix, each mode of length 1.
